claim: recheck prior finding F-001: A settings.get that throws synchronously freezes the panel
reason: Fixed: get runs inside .then, so a sync throw becomes a rejection; test "a settings read that throws at once..." passes (it hung on 8fd32f9).

claim: recheck prior finding F-002: firstLoad waits on the read it captured, so a stuck first read blocks a newer answer
reason: Fixed: waiters are resolved by the newest read, not by awaiting the captured promise.

claim: recheck prior finding F-003: The default moves the range while the Custom date fields are open
reason: Fixed: every range-button click, Custom included, sets rangePicked.

claim: A valid Default range read that answers before a newer read is discarded; if the newer read fails, the saved default is never applied this session.
class: newest-wins token discards an older valid answer when the newest answer is unusable
confidence: medium; needs a host get that rejects after a settings change during the first read. Host timeout per pack (plugin-panel-shell.js:115), not reread.
sweep: Other numbered reads in shard: none (only defaultRangeReads). Setting enum (orca-plugin.json:88-96) limits invalid values, so only failure path reaches it. checked-broken: none beyond this. not checked: other panels in repo with the same read pattern (out of shard).
trigger: 1. Panel opens; firstLoad calls readDefaultRange, read R1 (defaultRangeReads=1), host get slow. 2. Person changes defaultRange in Settings; onDidChange fires; R2 starts (defaultRangeReads=2). 3. R1 answers '30d'; panel.js:624 discards it (read 1 !== 2). 4. R2 get rejects (host timeout, plugin-panel-shell.js:115, 120 s). 5. R2 is newest: state.defaultRange stays '7d'; waiters resolve; firstLoad opens 7d (fallback already loaded 7d at 1.5 s). The 30d answer is lost; clearFilter('range') also goes to 7d.
wrong: Should: keep the last valid answer when the newest read is unusable, or fall back to the most recent valid read. Does: resets to the 7d default.

claim: When the default is applied after a 7d load is already in flight, the 7d report renders under a radio already set to the new range, a transient label mismatch.
class: state changed while a response for the old state is in flight, rendered without a range check
confidence: high that it happens; pack already calls it a probable flash. Low impact, no data loss.
reason: Self-correcting by design: load() queues one more load when state changes mid-request (comment and state.again at panel.js:49-50), the same path a range click during a load takes at baseline; the 30d report replaces the 7d one when it finishes.
sweep: checked-broken: none other. checked-fine: clearFilter (panel.js:158) changes range the same way but its load() is not queued behind a busy request in the same way; same flash possible in theory, not traced further. Not checked: render() range consistency beyond this path.
trigger: 1. Default range 30d; the first read is slow. 2. The 1.5 s fallback at panel.js:599 calls load() with state.range 7d; request in flight. 3. Read answers '30d'; firstLoad sets state.range='30d' and the radios (panel.js:607) at panel.js:611 load() (queued as state.again). 4. The 7d response arrives; load() calls render() (panel.js:63) with state.range '30d' selected over 7d totals. 5. finally runs load('usage.report') on 30d; the 30d report replaces it.
wrong: Should: show only the report matching the selected range. Does: one request of 7d numbers under the 30d control, then corrected.

class: newer-generation guard drops an older valid result when the newer one yields nothing

trigger: 1. Panel mounts; firstLoad starts read A (readDefaultRange, read=1, get pending). 2. User changes Default range; onDidChange fires; read B starts (defaultRangeReads=2). 3.
